restaged_sha_vs_a9f_manifest.reason: writer-version drift: the restage re-serialized the same endpoint windows with a different parquet writer; row VALUES are re-fetched observables whose equivalence is proven by the series digest + metric reproduction, not by file bytes

root_cause_findings.bars_digest_note: bars_digest still differs from the frozen preflight digest AFTER the fix: the digests cover every loaded slot of all 20 series, and the consumed surface is proven bit-identical by run-hash equality (positions_sha256, portfolio_payload_sha256, result_sha256, fold_metrics_sha256 AND benchmarks_sha256 all match per arm) -- so the digest delta lies on never-consumed slots (kline vintage differences between the CHR3F staging fetch and the V14 P1 assembly; e.g. the warmup week and non-held symbols' closes), none of which enter any fill, mark, benchmark or daily PnL row.
root_cause_findings.catalog_bar_stamping: FIRST RUN (pre-fix) was DIVERGENT with a precise structure: basis_digest, funding and every book/schedule surface matched bit-exactly, while 591/600 positions carried BOTH a different entry and exit price and the per-position price-PnL deltas summed to exactly the whole net divergence (+0.001505748227 frozen-mine price pnl; net delta 0.001505955656 = price delta + cost delta 2.07e-7) -- a +1-bar execution lag lookalike.  Root cause: catalog_live_crypto_a20 stamps each BinanceBar with ts_event = the kline OPEN time (verified against the raw staged monthly klines: open_time 1756080000000 carries close 0.0108651, the exact frozen fill price at the 00:15 boundary), while the frozen V14 staged bars index each bar by its CLOSE boundary.  The loader now remaps catalog rows to the boundary they terminate (snap(ts) + 15m, availability = close boundary).
root_cause_findings.ong_settlement_shortfall: scan_2026_a cannot reconstruct the frozen ONGUSDT settlement bundle (frozen 4418 rows vs 4409 restage: one 4h slot missing at 2026-06-24T04:00Z plus hourly-tail cadence rows past 2026-08-21T00:00Z that cannot be mapped back to the frozen fetch); the other 18 names trim cleanly to the frozen counts. funding_sum is nonetheless bit-exact on every arm, and the untrimmed-funding diagnostic shows delta 0.0 vs the trimmed primary run (the six trailing settlements on 8h names and the 2026-08-21T00:00Z boundary row never change any accrual).
root_cause_findings.restage_value_equivalence: basis_digest EQUALS the frozen preflight digest exactly (538d6fb5...): the restaged parquets are value-identical to the A9-F staged basis world (origin, premium bytes and availability bytes), so the recorded sha-vs-manifest mismatches are parquet writer metadata only -- the signal consumed by the scored run is bit-identical to the frozen one.
